column1: # Referenced-path exemptions for bootstrap/check-unit-drift.sh's REFERENCED-PATH
# check. Format: unit<TAB>relpath<TAB>evidence. Keyed on the EXACT unit+path
# pair, never on the unit alone -- a whole-unit exemption would silently
# license any future dangling reference added to that template under the
# original, unrelated justification (round-2 review defect 2, proven in
# check-unit-drift.test.ts: appending an unrelated ExecStartPost path to an
# already-exempted unit must NOT ride in on its pre-existing evidence).
# Absence with no entry here is a failure (Hard Floor 7) -- a path only lands
# here with a named reason, not by default.
# Ported unit templates point at scripts from v2-deprecated's layout. Some
# name mechanisms not yet built on v3 (tracked as their own workboard rows);
# others name a specific product's deployment paths, which HR-309 already
# rules belongs under instance/, not the generic mechanism directory -- see
# instance/units/ and instance/expected-units.tsv for that move. Both classes
# are real gaps, not silently patched over.
